description: Two full Auras with mandatory conditional two-cost reduction when chosen host already has an Aura. Quote and bind host before native payment, preserving manual mana/cancellation. regulationVerification.scope: Current premium and restricted headings excluding comments

coverage: Chosen host/new-GR mode is quoted before use; native mana transaction binds its exact ref and permits cancellation and encrypted continuation; normal and free grave deployment remain separate.

Mandatory discount counts ignored attached Auras, is exactly2, stacks with Chupakaru/floors1, stops under Diamondstar, obeys Water payment and sealed host restrictions; original printed cost remains unchanged.
Ze Gagil native up-to-two selection freezes attack/block immediately through opponent turn, ends at next own start and excludes untargetable/sealed/own creatures.
Unabarez tapped-host external selection protection survives ignored host but stops for ignored Aura; permits attacks, blocks, own choices and untargeted destruction.

Manual UI displays distinct host/cost labels; projected online actions preserve method choice rather than auto-executing; actual encrypted duel service both seats selects intended host and manual mana.
Actual Shelf Garchelf can choose the source Aura while its tapped host is protected; removing Aura or native start untap immediately ends protection.
validationNotes.resolvedAttempts: Corrected initial fixture spell IDs: dm01-027 is opposing Demon Hand; own choice uses dm01-086 Spiral Gate and untargeted destruction uses actual dm27-001 Violence Heaven. Projected actions intentionally omit raw private action fields/cost, so compare authoritative labels/IDs and requiresMethod, then verify actual server moves. Single eligible target auto-completes native up-to-two choice; no extra null selection. Additional helper optimization returns non-play actions before looking up their source; focused and affected related regressions repeated against final production files. Source-Aura removal fixture initially used cost-three-or-less Zark Ho Pitch against a cost-six Aura; switched to existing unlimited element removal Shelf Garchelf.
